solvency_margin.definition: Biên khả năng thanh toán: ratio of available capital to required minimum. Must be ≥ 100%. Below 100% triggers MoF corrective action; below 80% triggers enhanced supervision.

charter_capital.definition: Vốn điều lệ tối thiểu: minimum registered capital. Life: VND 750 billion (~USD 30M). Non-life: VND 400 billion (~USD 16M). Health standalone: VND 400 billion. Reinsurer: VND 500 billion. Broker: VND 8 billion.

combined_ratio.definition: Tỷ lệ kết hợp = Tỷ lệ bồi thường (loss ratio) + Tỷ lệ chi phí (expense ratio). Loss ratio = incurred losses / earned premium. Expense ratio = operating expenses / written premium. Target < 100% for underwriting profitability.

persistency_rate.definition: Tỷ lệ duy trì hợp đồng: percentage of policies remaining in force. Measured at 13th month and 25th month. Vietnam average ~60-70% at 13th month — lower than mature markets due to bancassurance mis-selling issues.

cooling_off_period.definition: Thời gian xem xét hợp đồng: 21 calendar days from policy delivery for all life insurance policies. Policyholder may cancel with full premium refund minus medical exam costs. Mandatory disclosure required at point of sale.

technical_provisions.definition: Dự phòng nghiệp vụ (DPNV): reserves insurers must maintain. Includes: dự phòng toán học (mathematical/life), dự phòng phí chưa được hưởng (unearned premium), dự phòng bồi thường (outstanding claims + IBNR), dự phòng dao động lớn (catastrophe). Calculated per TT 132/2023.

compulsory_motor_tnds.definition: BH TNDS bắt buộc chủ xe cơ giới: compulsory motor third-party liability. Covers VND 150M per person per incident bodily injury and VND 100M property damage. Premium fixed by government decree. All registered vehicles must carry.

compulsory_fire_explosion.definition: BH cháy nổ bắt buộc: compulsory fire and explosion insurance for facilities on government high-risk list (Danh mục cơ sở nguy hiểm). Premium rate fixed by MoF. Covers fire, explosion, lightning damage.

rag_chunks: Vietnam insurance is regulated by Cục Quản lý, Giám sát Bảo hiểm (ISA) under Bộ Tài chính (MoF). Primary law: Luật KDBH 2022 (Law 08/2022/QH15), 147 articles, effective 2023-01-01. Key implementing: NĐ 46/2023 (general), NĐ 67/2023 (compulsory insurance), TT 67/2023 (guidance), TT 132/2023 (financial regime). Transitioning to risk-based supervision.

Solvency requirements per TT 132/2023: Biên khả năng thanh toán (solvency margin) ≥ 100%. Charter capital: life VND 750B, non-life VND 400B, reinsurer VND 500B, broker VND 8B. DPNV includes: dự phòng toán học (mathematical), phí chưa được hưởng (unearned premium), bồi thường (claims), dao động lớn (catastrophe). Below 100% → corrective action; below 80% → enhanced supervision.

Compulsory insurance (BHBB) per NĐ 67/2023: (1) Motor TNDS — all vehicles, VND 150M/person bodily injury, VND 100M property per incident; (2) Fire/explosion — high-risk facilities per TT 70/2023; (3) Professional liability — brokers, notaries, construction consultants. Government-fixed premiums for compulsory lines.

Bancassurance generates 70%+ of life new business. Post-2022 mis-selling crisis, regulations require: mandatory needs analysis form, no forced bundling with loans, 21-day cooling-off for all life policies, audio/video recording of sales, separation from banking counter. Major deals: Vietcombank-FWD, VietinBank-Manulife, VPBank-AIA, BIDV-MetLife, MB-Ageas.

Vietnam life insurance products: Bảo hiểm hỗn hợp (endowment — most popular), Bảo hiểm liên kết đầu tư (unit-linked — under scrutiny), Bảo hiểm giáo dục (education endowment — very popular), Bảo hiểm hưu trí (retirement — tax deductible up to VND 3M/month), Bảo hiểm tử kỳ (term life). 13th-month persistency averages 60-70%.

Non-life key lines: Motor (~25-30% of premium), Health (fastest growing 15-20%), Property/fire, Marine/cargo, Engineering/construction, Agricultural (government-subsidized 60-90% under QĐ 13/2022). Combined ratio = loss ratio + expense ratio; target < 100%. Top carriers: Bảo Việt, PVI, Bảo Minh.

Insurance AML per Luật PCRT 2022 and NĐ 19/2023: KYC/CDD for all policyholders, EDD for PEPs and large single premiums, STR to Cục PCRT within 48 hours, 5-year record retention. Life insurance higher AML risk due to cash surrender values. Data protection per NĐ 13/2023 requires consent, DPIA, data residency.

Claims process: FNOL → Coverage verification → Giám định (survey/adjustment) → Reserve setting → Settlement → Subrogation (thế quyền). SLA: 15 days standard, 30 days complex. Claims authority: adjuster <VND 200M, supervisor 200M-1B, manager 1B-5B, director 5B-20B, C-suite >20B. Fraud detection via SIU (Đơn vị Điều tra Gian lận).
rag_chunks_v6: The Chief Compliance Officer (Giám đốc Tuân thủ) of a Vietnamese insurer guards insurance law and reports to MoF/ISA. KPIs: zero critical findings from ISA inspections, 100% of products registered per Decree 46/2023, STRs filed within 48 hours per the 2022 AML Law, 100% of bancassurance sales carrying a needs analysis form, and the quarterly solvency report filed on time. Product registration weighs actuarial certification, terms compliance, illustration accuracy and consumer disclosure, and produces the MoF filing dossier, launch approval and distribution readiness, escalating to the CEO.

Bancassurance conduct review in Vietnam checks four things: the needs analysis was completed, the sale was audio and video recorded, there was no forced bundling with a loan, and the 21-day cooling-off period was communicated. The outcome is compliance clearance, a remediation action or a training requirement, escalated to the CEO. A bancassurance referral goes to the underwriter with the needs analysis form, CCCD verification, the signed product illustration (bảng minh họa), the recording and a no-forced-bundling confirmation, and is processed within 48 hours.

The Chief Actuary (Chuyên gia Định phí trưởng) of a Vietnamese insurer keeps the solvency margin at or above 100% per Circular 132/2023, technical provisions (DPNV) within the actuarial range, A/E pricing ratios within plus or minus 10%, and gives actuarial sign-off on every product before MoF filing. Reserve estimation weighs loss triangle development, claim frequency and severity trends and catastrophe exposure, and outputs a DPNV recommendation, its solvency impact and reinsurance recovery, escalating to the CFO. Pricing adequacy weighs loss experience, expense loading, investment income, profit margin and competitive position.

How each technical provision is calculated: the mathematical reserve (dự phòng toán học) for life business uses the net premium or prospective method; the unearned premium reserve (dự phòng phí chưa được hưởng) for non-life uses pro rata temporis; the outstanding claims reserve (dự phòng bồi thường) is set case by case plus IBNR; and the catastrophe or equalisation reserve (dự phòng dao động lớn) follows the rate prescribed by the MoF. A solvency margin below 100% triggers MoF intervention and below 80% enhanced supervision.

Minimum charter capital (vốn điều lệ) per Decree 46/2023 in the ontology: life insurer VND 750 billion (about USD 30 million), non-life VND 400 billion (about USD 16 million), standalone health insurer VND 400 billion, reinsurer VND 500 billion and broker VND 8 billion.

The Chief Claims Officer (Giám đốc Bồi thường) targets a claims cycle of 15 business days for standard claims and 30 for complex ones, customer satisfaction above 80%, active fraud detection and subrogation (thế quyền) recovery above 30%. Claims vocabulary: giám định (survey), giám định viên (surveyor), biên bản giám định (survey report), mức miễn thường (deductible), từ chối bồi thường (claim denial) and thời hiệu khiếu nại (time limit for complaints). FNOL goes to a claims adjuster with loss details, policy verification, initial reserve and fraud screening, assigned within 24 hours, or 4 hours in a catastrophe.

Claims settlement authority at a Vietnamese insurer: L1 adjuster below VND 200 million, L2 supervisor VND 200 million to 1 billion, L3 manager VND 1 to 5 billion, L4 director VND 5 to 20 billion, L5 C-suite above VND 20 billion. Underwriting authority: L1 underwriter for standard risk within appetite, L2 senior underwriter for complex or substandard risk, L3 manager for large risk or unusual exposure, and L4 Chief Underwriting Officer for an exception beyond appetite.

Reinsurance handoffs: when a risk exceeds retention capacity, the senior underwriter sends the reinsurance manager the risk details, retention limit and cession requirement, and placement takes 5 business days. When a claim exceeds the retention threshold, the claims manager notifies reinsurance recovery within 48 hours of the large loss with the claim details, reserve amount and treaty terms. A new product goes from compliance to MoF/ISA with actuarial certification, policy terms, premium schedule, benefit illustration and consumer disclosure; MoF review takes 30-60 days.

Law 08/2022/QH15 on insurance business has 147 articles in 9 chapters and took effect on 1 January 2023. It moves supervision from rule-based to risk-based, gives microinsurance its first legal framework in Chapter VII, makes e-contracts valid under Articles 97-98, adds the 21-day cooling-off and mandatory disclosure, and strengthens governance. Decree 46/2023 covers licensing, capital, solvency, investment limits, distribution, product approval and microinsurance (Articles 86-95). Circular 67/2023 covers product filing, actuarial requirements and reporting templates; Circular 132/2023 covers financial reporting, valuation, solvency, DPNV methodology and investment rules.

The cooling-off period (thời gian xem xét hợp đồng) is 21 calendar days from policy delivery for every life policy; the policyholder can cancel for a full premium refund less medical examination costs, and it must be disclosed at the point of sale. Compulsory motor third-party liability (BH TNDS bắt buộc) covers VND 150 million per person per incident for bodily injury and VND 100 million per incident for property, with a premium fixed by decree. Compulsory fire and explosion cover applies to facilities on the government's high-risk list, at a rate fixed by the MoF, covering fire, explosion and lightning.

Persistency (tỷ lệ duy trì hợp đồng) is measured at the 13th and 25th months; Vietnam's 13th-month average of 60-70% is below mature markets because of bancassurance mis-selling. The target is above 80%, and below 60% is a concern. The Chief Distribution Officer (Giám đốc Kênh Phân phối) tracks new business premium growth, premium per active agent, 13th-month bancassurance persistency above 70% and digital channel share, using terms such as đại lý (agent), môi giới (broker), hoa hồng (commission) and APE. A combined ratio below 90% is world class.
